# RadioReach

> Radio station contacts and radio promotion resources for independent
> musicians and artists.

RadioReach publishes the Radio Reach Vault, a downloadable database of radio
station contact information, alongside free guides that explain how to research
stations and pitch them without spamming. RadioReach does not sell airplay and
does not guarantee placement; it reduces the time artists spend locating and
organizing prospective radio contacts.

## Pages

- [Radio Reach Vault (home)](https://radioreach.us/): Radio station contacts for
  independent musicians — college, community, commercial and online radio. $20 USD,
  instant download, 30-day refund policy.
- [Resources hub](https://radioreach.us/resources/): Index of the free radio
  promotion guides.
- [How to Find Radio Stations Accepting Music Submissions](https://radioreach.us/resources/radio-stations-accepting-music/):
  Narrowing stations by genre, geography, format and programming; which station
  contacts matter; what a submission email should contain.
- [College Radio Submissions for Independent Artists](https://radioreach.us/resources/college-radio-submissions/):
  Who to contact at a college station, how to submit, and whether college stations
  accept independent music.
- [Radio Promotion for Independent Artists](https://radioreach.us/resources/radio-promotion-independent-artists/):
  Building a relevant contact list, pitching programmers, and using geography
  strategically.
